t.title: Tilaawadaha Qur'aanka Kariimka
t.allImamsSub: Suurad kasta imaam kale ayaa akhriya
t.hintTar: Suurad kasta sannad kale, mar hore iyo mar dhow
t.hintDragDial: Jiid tilmaamaha si aad suurad u doorato
t.hintDragBar: Jiid xarriiqda si aad suurad u doorato
t.dragOff: Tilmaamuhu wuu dhaqaaqaa markaad doorato Masxaf ama sannad
t.dragOffBar: Xarriiqda waa la jiidi karaa markaad doorato Masxaf ama sannad
t.appsH: Ku dhageyso app-kaaga ama soo deji
t.m3uH: 2. Liiska ciyaarta M3U (iyo soo dejinta)
t.fMusS: Masxafyo la akhriyey oo dhammaystiran; Masxafka akhriste kasta wuxuu qayb gaar ah ku leeyahay app-ka podcast-ka.
t.fTarS: Salaadaha Taraawiixda ee Masjidka Nabiga; sannad kasta wuxuu qayb gaar ah ku leeyahay app-ka podcast-ka.
t.fAllS: Dhammaan tilaawadaha raadiyaha ee akhristayaal kala duwan, sida ay ugu kala horreeyaan Masxafka, tilaawadaha cusubna si toos ah ayay kuu soo gaaraan.
t.copiedHint: Linkiga waa la koobiyeeyey. Ku dheji app-kaaga.
t.alexaMore: Raadiyuhu wuxuu ka bilaabanayaa halka uu bogga ka baahinayo. Si aad u maamusho: “Alexa, next” suuradda xigta, iyo “Alexa, stop” si aad u joojiso.
t.liveH: 1. Raadiyaha Tartil oo toos ah, baahin toos ah (raadiyo)
t.altLiveD: Wuxuu ka shaqeeyaa dhammaan qalabka, xitaa kuwa duugga ah
t.vlcPc: Linkiga M3U ama baahinta tooska ah ee VLC: koobiyee linkiga → fur VLC → Media → Open Network Stream (Ctrl+N) → dheji linkiga → Play. Liisaska u shid Loop (ku celcelin).
t.vlcIos: Linkiga M3U ama baahinta tooska ah ee VLC: koobiyee linkiga → fur VLC → Network → Network Stream → dheji linkiga → Open Network Stream.
t.vlcAnd: Linkiga M3U ama baahinta tooska ah ee VLC: koobiyee linkiga → fur VLC → More → New stream → dheji linkiga → Play. Linkiga baahinta tooska ahi wuxuu kale oo uu ka shaqeeyaa app kasta oo raadiyo ah oo oggol in idaacad lagu daro link.
t.rssPc: Linkiga RSS ee Pocket Casts (pocketcasts.com ama app-ka): Search → si toos ah ugu dheji linkiga sanduuqa raadinta → Subscribe.
t.rssMac: Linkiga RSS ee Apple Podcasts (Mac): liiska File → Follow a Show by URL → dheji linkiga.
t.rssAp: Linkiga RSS ee Apple Podcasts: Library → ⋯ ama Edit → Follow a Show by URL → dheji linkiga.
t.rssOv: Linkiga RSS ee Overcast: + → Add URL → dheji linkiga.
t.rssAnd: Linkiga RSS ee Podcast Addict / AntennaPod: badhanka + → Add by RSS URL → dheji linkiga.
t.rssPcA: Linkiga RSS ee Pocket Casts: Search → si toos ah ugu dheji linkiga sanduuqa raadinta → Subscribe.
t.dlAllH: Soo deji dhammaan tilaawadaha hal mar
t.dlAllHint: Baaxadda awgeed ma jiro hal fayl ZIP ah; habka ugu fudud waa liis linkiyo ah oo aad gelinayso barnaamij soo dejin, si uu hal mar u soo dejiyo dhammaan:
t.dlPc: Kombiyuutar: JDownloader ama Internet Download Manager → ku dar linkiyo → dheji waxa ku jira faylka ama soo geli.
t.dlAnd: Android: app-ka ADM → liiska linkiyada ka soo geli faylka.
t.waqf: Raadiyahan waa waqf loo sameeyey Alle Kor ahaaye dartiis. Ka qayb qaado faafintiisa, waayo kii khayr ku tilmaama wuxuu la mid yahay kii sameeya.
t.mailL: Faallooyinka iyo soo jeedinta, iyo qof kasta oo xuquuq ku leh maaddo halkan ku jirta, waan ka saaraynaa isla marka uu codsado:
t.loadErr: Tilaawaddan lama soo dejin karin, waxaan u gudbaynaa tan xigta…
t.plErr: Liiska ciyaarta lama soo dejin karin.
t.shareMsg: Dhageyso raadiyaha “Tilaawadaha Qur'aanka Kariimka” si toos ah habeen iyo maalin
t.instBarS: Raadiyaha ku fur hal taabasho, sida app
t.instIos1: Taabo badhanka La wadaag {share} ee barta browser-ka
t.instIosN: Safari-ga badhanka La wadaag wuxuu ku yaal barta hoose
t.instPcS: Chrome iyo Edge daaqadda rakibiddu si toos ah ayay u soo baxdaa. Browser-yada kale:
t.instPc2: Firefox: astaanta qufulka ka jiid barta cinwaanka una keen desktop-ka

m.tfSrc: Isha: Al-Mukhtasar fi Tafsir al-Quran al-Karim, Xarunta Tafsiir ee Daraasaadka Qur'aanka
m.dockE: Taabo aayad kasta si aad u akhrido tafsiirkeeda kooban ee “Al-Mukhtasar fi al-Tafsir”, aad u koobiyeyso, ama aad calaamad joogsi u dhigto.
m.dockH: Fallaadhaha ← → si aad bogagga u rogto
m.resGo: Ka sii wad halkii aan ka joogsaday
m.noMarks: Weli calaamado joogsi ma jiraan. Taabo aayad kasta, kadibna “Calaamad joogsi”.
m.sPh: Qor hal eray ama in ka badan oo Carabi ah si aad Qur'aanka uga raadiso
m.sCount: {n} aayadood · taabo natiijada si aad boggeeda u furto
m.sLoad: Waxaa la soo dejinayaa tusmada raadinta…
m.errLoad: Lama soo dejin karin. Hubi xiriirkaaga kadibna isku day mar kale.
m.lastPos: Meeshii ugu dambaysay ee aad gaartay
